Title: User submits valid name and phone number on the User Details page
Preconditions: Streamlit app (ui/app.py) and backend API (backend/main.py) are both running
Steps: 1. Launch the app and land on the Home page | 2. Select 'Contact Us' from the sidebar | 3. Click 'Continue to User Details' | 4. Enter a valid full name | 5. Enter a valid phone number | 6. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: A green success message 'Thank you, Jane Doe! Your details have been submitted.' is shown and the submitted details (including a generated id and timestamp) are displayed in a JSON block below the form

Title: Full navigation flow from Home through Contact Us to a persisted User Details record
Preconditions: Backend API is running and reachable at BACKEND_URL; SQLite data/app.db is writable
Steps: 1. Open the app on the Home page | 2. Navigate to 'Contact Us' via sidebar | 3. Read contact info and click 'Continue to User Details ➜' | 4. Confirm the page switches to 'User Details' | 5. Fill in name and phone and click Submit | 6. Query GET /api/user-details on the backend
Expected Result: The UI transitions Contact Us -> User Details, the POST /api/user-details call returns HTTP 201, and the new record (with matching name/phone) appears in the GET /api/user-details list

Title: Phone number at minimum allowed length (7 digits) is accepted
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Details page | 2. Enter a valid name | 3. Enter a 7-digit phone number | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Form is accepted, backend returns HTTP 201, and success message with submitted JSON is displayed

Title: Phone number exceeding maximum allowed length (16+ digits) is rejected
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Details page | 2. Enter a valid name | 3. Enter a 16-digit phone number | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Inline error 'Phone number must contain 7-15 digits, optionally prefixed with +.' is shown and no record is created

Title: Name field accepts and trims leading/trailing whitespace
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Details page | 2. Enter a name with leading/trailing spaces | 3. Enter a valid phone number | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Submission succeeds and the displayed/stored name is trimmed to 'Maria Gomez' with no leading/trailing spaces

Title: Submitting the form with an empty name is rejected
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Details page | 2. Leave the Full Name field blank | 3. Enter a valid phone number | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Inline error 'Name is required.' is displayed and no request reaches the backend / no record is created

Title: Submitting the form with a non-numeric phone number is rejected
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Details page | 2. Enter a valid name | 3. Enter a phone number containing letters | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Inline error 'Phone number must contain 7-15 digits, optionally prefixed with +.' is displayed and no record is created

Title: Backend unreachable is handled gracefully by the UI
Preconditions: Backend API process is stopped while the Streamlit app remains running
Steps: 1. Stop the backend service | 2. Navigate to User Details page | 3. Enter a valid name and phone number | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: A warning message is shown stating the details were saved locally but the backend could not be reached, and the entered data is still displayed in the JSON block
